title: Unusual Transaction Amount
content: A transaction amount significantly higher than the user's historical average can indicate unusual spending behavior, account takeover, or unauthorized payment activity.

title: High Transaction Velocity
content: A high number of transactions within a short period can indicate automated abuse, card testing, rapid unauthorized purchases, or account takeover activity.

title: New Device
content: A transaction from a device not previously associated with the user's account can indicate credential compromise or unauthorized account access.

title: New Location
content: A transaction originating from a location that is unusual for the user can indicate account takeover or unauthorized access.

title: International Transaction
content: An international transaction may increase fraud risk when it differs from the user's normal geographic or spending behavior.

title: High-Risk Merchant
content: Transactions involving merchants with elevated historical or categorical risk may require additional fraud investigation.

title: Multiple Failed Attempts
content: Several failed transaction attempts within a short period can indicate payment testing, credential attacks, or unauthorized activity.

title: Unusual Transaction Time
content: Transactions occurring during unusual hours may be suspicious when they differ significantly from the user's normal transaction behavior.

title: Unusual Geographic Distance
content: A transaction occurring far from the user's normal location can indicate unusual geographic behavior or possible account compromise.
